grain: one row per component per day
note: Primary health monitoring table for the dashboard. Health score is penalized by critical (100%) and warning (50%) readings.

columns.name: total_readings
columns.note: Total sensor readings that day (288 = full day at 5-min intervals)

columns.name: critical_readings
columns.note: Count of readings where health_status was 'Critical'

columns.name: warning_readings
columns.note: Count of readings where health_status was 'Warning'

columns.name: critical_reading_code
columns.note: Numeric fault code (e.g. 288 = High Discharge Temperature). Maps to config/critical_reading_codes.json. 0 = no fault.

columns.name: critical_event_count
columns.note: Number of discrete fault events/spikes during the day
